blind_spots.blind_spot: The therapeutic runs entirely on a personal Apple Watch/App-Store-adjacent stack with no discussion of provisioning, data flow, or authorization on government health networks.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A VA or base clinic can't build a standard-of-care pathway around a device tied to a service member's personal Apple ID with an undocumented path into a DoD/VA EHR — the ATO and health-IT integration question is exactly what determines if this ever leaves the pilot-partner stage.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The consumer/patient-facing site describes the sensor and real-time monitoring purely as a clinical feature, never as an institutional deployment dependency.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: NightWare uses the Apple Watch® heart monitor sensor and other biometric sensors to determine when someone is having a nightmare.

blind_spots.blind_spot: Adoption messaging is a consumer email-capture funnel, not an institutional training/sustainment program for scaling across VA or base clinics.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Reaching a fleet of VA facilities needs a train-the-trainer plan, device replacement/fitting logistics, and a clinical champion above the individual prescriber — 'sign up for alerts' is patient marketing, not the adoption infrastructure a 7-person company (headcount down 8.3% YoY) needs to survive its own scaling ambition.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The company has spent its resources on FDA clearance and one partner deal (First Nation Group, 2020); the April 2026 capital raise announcement itself signals the scaling plan still doesn't exist yet.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: If you would like to receive news and alerts from the company, please provide your email below and we will keep you informed of important developments.

blind_spots.blind_spot: The SBIR abstract's entire barrier narrative is clinical underreporting/underdiagnosis; it never engages the government-acquisition or health-IT compliance barrier that actually gates base-clinic rollout.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Even a clinically validated, FDA-cleared device needs an Authority to Operate on military health networks and EHR interoperability before a base clinic can prescribe it at scale — a completely different obstacle from the diagnosis-underreporting problem the abstract spends its whole argument on.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The abstract is written to justify the clinical need for the therapy, not to plan the acquisition pathway that gets it into a treatment room.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Patients under-report nightmares to their physicians and it remains underdiagnosed... 60% of patients with recurrent nightmares do not discuss it with their health care providers.

opener_hook: Your AFWERX Force Resilience abstract cites 31.2% of active-duty patients at military sleep clinics reporting weekly nightmares — your April 2026 release says you're now raising capital to reach the VA at scale.
what_they_do: FDA-cleared prescription digital therapeutic that uses an Apple Watch to detect and interrupt PTSD-related nightmares with haptic feedback.
